title: Presto 7 function canning kit
text: Presto 7 function canning kit. Just a beginner and so I purchased this kit.  My Mom (well seasoned canner) approved.  Said that it includes the "useful" tools you discover you need once you start.  You get everything shown in the photo, tools are a sort of lime green.  I will update my review if new info will be useful.

product_metadata.title: Presto 7 Function Canning Kit
features: Funnel for filling regular and wide mouth canning jars
Bubble remover for releasing trapped air bubbles
Magnetic lid lifter removes canning lids from hot water
Kitchen tongs for easy handling of hot foods for canning
Jar lifter easily removes hot jars from canner Jar wrench helps to remove sticky screw bands
description: Handy tools for easy home canning! This 7-function accessory kit includes a digital timer, canning funnel, combination bubble remover/magnetic lid lifter, jar lifter, kitchen tongs, and jar wrench. The digital timer, with battery included, accurately counts down processing times from any time up to 99 minutes and 59 seconds. Counts up for use as a stopwatch too! Timer features a large digital display with a clip, easel stand, and magnet on back for convenient use. The canning funnel assures easy and neat filling of regular or wide-mouth canning jars. The flat end of the combination bubble remover/magnetic lid lifter gently releases trapped air bubbles from liquid in jars. Use the magnetic end to assist in lifting canning lids from hot water. Jar lifter helps to place jars in canner before processing and then safely and easily removes hot jars after processing. Kitchen tongs provide safe handling of hot foods for canning. Jar wrench helps to remove screw bands that have become stuck in place during processing.
